note: Permanent error tests. Every error found by hand becomes a test here, so the same kind of mistake is caught every hour, for ever. one_case: every counted report matching the pattern is in exactly one case. apart: no case holds reports matching both patterns. not_incident: no counted case holds a report matching the pattern. type: every counted case holding a matching report has this type. not_fatal: no such case is marked as a death. organised: a matching report is listed under Organised crime. situation_placed: the live situation holding a matching report has an area. region: such cases lie in this part of the district (city, pcmc, rural). Patterns are case-insensitive regular expressions on headlines.
